name: Shema
overview: The name Shema appears in Scripture referring to various individuals and a location within the tribe of Judah. It is the name of a city in Judah (Joshua 15:26) and also identifies several men, including a son of Hebron (1 Chronicles 2:43-44), a Benjamite leader (1 Chronicles 8:13), and a man who stood at Ezra's right hand as the law was read to the people (Nehemiah 8:4). These references highlight Shema as a figure connected to both tribal heritage and faithful service in the post-exilic community.
